subject: Intro: OpenRepo → Redwood demo & GitHub App permissions
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@openrepo.dev>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T15:02:00Z
Subject: Interested in Redwood for GitHub integration — can we demo?

Hi Avery,

We just signed up for a trial this morning after reading your docs — nice work. OpenRepo is evaluating tooling to surface code ownership signals and automate code review triage. A few of our engineers poked the self-serve flow and we have specific questions about the GitHub App permissions and whether Redwood can operate at org-level for private repos.

Would love to schedule a quick 30-minute demo to see the integration end-to-end and ask about these permissions. Our team is based in PST (San Francisco). Good windows are:
- Thu 11/19 between 10:30–12:00 PST
- Fri 11/20 after 09:00 PST

Can you also confirm whether we need install-level admin rights vs. repo-level install?

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform
OpenRepo

PS — I can bring our infra lead Lina if that helps (lina@openrepo.dev).

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@openrepo.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T17:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood for GitHub integration — can we demo?

Hi Samir — great to meet you (and welcome to Redwood!). Thanks for signing up and for the clear time windows. 30 minutes sounds perfect.

I can host a demo and loop in Marissa (solutions AE) to cover the integration nuances. Proposed slots (all PST):
- Thu 11/19, 11:00–11:30
- Fri 11/20, 09:30–10:00

Please pick whichever works best or paste an invite if you prefer. Here’s a quick pre-demo checklist to speed things up: we generally ask for repo-level access to start but can discuss org-level install depending on the scale. I attached a short checklist and a one-pager with the integration summary.

Pre-demo asks:
- If you want us to show private repo demos, please add lina@openrepo.dev as a collaborator or grant a temporary token.
- Share a representative repo name (no credentials in email).

Scheduler: https://cal.redwood.com/s/avery-johnson/30min

Thanks — I’ll hold both slots until I hear back.

Best,
Avery Johnson
SDR, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf, redwood-product-onepager.pdf

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T17:48:00Z
Subject: Fwd: OpenRepo inbound — please prep for permissions Qs

Marissa / Ben — forwarding the inbound. Samir is an org-level/OSS maintainer asking about GitHub App permissions and private repo demos.

Agenda for the 30m:
1) Intros + quick product recap (5m)
2) Live demo of GitHub integration on a sample private repo (15m)
3) Permissions & install options: repo vs org vs token-based (5m)
4) Next steps & mutual action plan (5m)

Marissa — can you prepare the short permissions summary (one slide) and be ready to show the app install flow? Ben — flag any known limitations for org-scoped installs (e.g., SSO or enterprise restrictions).

Thanks — I’ll update the invite once Samir confirms a slot.

- Avery

From: Samir Gupta <samir@openrepo.dev>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Park <lina@openrepo.dev>
Date: 2026-11-19T01:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood for GitHub integration — can we demo?

Hi Avery — thanks for the quick reply. Lina will join. The Friday 11/20 09:30–10:00 PST slot works best for us. Please send an invite to both of us.

Two quick clarifications before the call:
- We use GitHub Enterprise Cloud with SAML SSO; will the GitHub App require org admin approval?
- Our security team prefers minimal perms. Is repo-level install sufficient to demo the main features?

I can share the repo name privately once you confirm the slot and preferred method for temporary access.

Regards,
Samir

Attachment: integration-perms-summary.txt (brief notes from our infra team)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@openrepo.dev>, Lina Park <lina@openrepo.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T10:45:00Z
Subject: Confirmed — Redwood demo Fri 11/20 09:30 PST (calendar invite attached)

Perfect — confirmed. I’ve scheduled Fri 2026-11-20 09:30–10:00 PST and attached the calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics). Marissa will run the demo; I’ll handle intros and next steps.

Quick answers ahead of the call:
- GitHub Enterprise + SAML: the App typically needs an org admin to approve an org-level install. However, for demos you can install at repo-level without org admin; that’s the recommended path when security wants minimal permissions.
- Repo-level install: sufficient to demo code-level features and the webhook flows. For org-wide ingestion we’ll discuss the enterprise install and best practices during the call.

Pre-call checklist (again):
- Add lina@openrepo.dev as a collaborator on one private repo OR provide a temporary deploy key/token (do not paste tokens in email).
- Share the repo name in private chat or add to the calendar invite notes.

Drive runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-integration-runbook

See you Fri — thanks!

Best,
Avery Johnson
SDR, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics
